purpose: Improve Dragapult and Rayquaza against frozen v6 Zoroark, then preserve the process for future coevolution.

method.policy: heuristic action scores and explicit target-selection hooks
method.parameterOptimization: finite population search followed by separate validation

entryPoints.tuneDragapult: node sim/run.js rivals train --only dragapult --ablate --tag drag3 --pop 12 --games 100 --validation 300 --seed 120000

nextGeneration: Freeze accepted rivals before improving Zoroark.
Train against a mixture of new and historical champions.
Keep opponent-specific results and a full matchup matrix.
Retire test seeds after inspecting them for further tuning.
Never edit an old comparison snapshot.
knownLimits: Fixed decks and opponent only; not a human tournament benchmark.
No guarantee of monotonic or unlimited progress.
Heuristic approximations remain in threat, promotion and energy valuation.
Initial population raw data was overwritten; its summary and selected parameters were recovered with source-hash verification.
Several tactically plausible Dragapult changes were rejected after an independent loss; final Dragapult uses v6 deck policy with selected parameters and smart attachment only.
Interim Rayquaza runs used different parameter files; do not pool those scores. The final tagged run restores the original selected parameter file and verifies its hash.

results.interpretation: Observed small gain; clear improvement not established.
Independent fixed-opponent improvement confirmed; no general human-player strength guarantee.

goalStatus.rayquaza: Improved against fixed v6 Zoroark: 11.30% to 14.80%, paired exact p=0.00001225.
goalStatus.dragapult: small observed gain; reliable strength improvement remains unproven
